answer: Each epoch the network auctions violet identity leases in sealed bids: one lease per identity, valid one epoch, priced at the lowest winning bid. An honest agent bids once — about 30 tokens, credited back against its earnings. A farmer needing 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 leases, so 30,000 tokens per epoch, and its own bids push the price up. Bids sharing one funding source are grouped in a sable ledger; any cluster bidding for over five leases triggers a yarrow audit, a live task each leaseholder must pass alone. Failures forfeit every lease in the cluster.
